title: Fragment-stage push constant update at offset 64 into a layout whose only range is vertex-stage
fix_note: no upstream fix (reported only); the fixed variant follows the issue's answer: the layout's range includes the fragment stage and the pushes name every stage of that range
expected_finding: vkCmdPushConstants(FRAGMENT, offset 64, size 4) on the world layout, whose only push constant range is VERTEX 0..256; fsWorld reads fragmentValue at byte 64 but no range makes it visible to the fragment stage (VUID-vkCmdPushConstants-offset-01795/01796)
